## Scope check

This project deliberately keeps a narrow scope. Confirm your request is not one
of the following, which are out of scope for the current experimental line:

- Firmware flashing, OTA updates or factory reset automation
- Automatic Wi-Fi reconfiguration of the camera
- Reimplementing the vendor transport without the SDK
- Claims of support for camera models or platforms that have not been tested
